name: s05-differentiation
title: Cell-state differentiation
question: Can environmental gradients create stable cell-state differentiation without a dedicated developmental program? (Q4, Q3)
hypothesis: Metabolite exchange plus inducible cell fate yields specialization that improves out-of-sample group performance beyond a no-fate and random-fate null (C5).
claim: In a 2D CPM world with an O2 gradient, O2-keyed germ/soma specialization (fixed a-priori stemness threshold) improves net viable growth out-of-sample on held-out env B (o2_source 0.025): decisively over a random-fate null and modestly (~5%) over a no-fate / clamped-undifferentiated null, in a moderate O2 regime. The benefit vanishes when O2 is plentiful and degrades when O2 is very scarce; transient 40-update window, one CPM backend.

behavior_tests.name: specialization-improves-group-performance
behavior_tests.description: Net viable biomass growth (viable_biomass last - first update) of the O2-keyed differentiation arm beats the no-fate, random-fate and clamped-undifferentiated nulls on held-out env B (seed-mean over 3 seeds). Decision criterion: specialization_out_of_sample_gain > 0. Env A (o2_source 0.02) is characterization only. The stemness threshold is fixed a priori, not tuned on A.

literature_anchors.source: Grosberg & Strathmann 2007, Annu Rev Ecol Evol Syst

baseline.name: baseline
baseline.note: Spatial O2-gradient germ/soma differentiation on the viva-cpm world (oxygen fate rule, calibration env A). n_steps=40 pins the transient window (the runner ignores the composite default).

limitations: Transient, quasi-static 40-update window on a single CPM backend (viva-cpm), 2D; not a steady state.

The fate rule / stemness threshold is FIXED a priori and not tuned to data; this is a generalization-across-regimes test (env A -> held-out env B), not a data-fit cross-validation. Only two O2 regimes are graded.

Benefit over the no-fate/clamped nulls is modest; it vanishes when O2 is plentiful (o2_source 0.03: no hypoxia, no differentiation, oxygen == none) and degrades/noisy when O2 is very scarce (0.015: over-differentiation, ~20/25 soma). These off-grid regimes were probed informally, not in the graded runs.
Performance metric (net viable biomass growth under O2 limitation) is a builder/owner-sanctioned choice (ruling S05-B).
verdict_rationale: Earned by a real 24-run study (4 arms x 2 O2 environments x 3 seeds). On held-out env B (o2_source 0.025) seed-mean net viable growth is oxygen 285.0 > none 270.0 = clamped 270.0 > random 159.7, an out-of-sample gain of +15.0 over the best null (calibration env A: 195.7 vs 163.3 vs 121.7). The benefit over the random-fate null is decisive (the O2-keyed spatial pattern matters; randomly placed soma waste growth) but over the no-fate/clamped nulls it is modest (~5% on B, ~20% on A; none and clamped are identical). Provisional: it vanishes when O2 is plentiful (o2_source 0.03, no hypoxia, no differentiation) and is noisy/degraded when O2 is very scarce (0.015, over-differentiation); transient 40-update window, single CPM backend, 2D, and the stemness threshold is a fixed a-priori parameter, so this is a generalization-across-O2-regimes test, not a data-fit cross-validation.
falsifiability: Oxygen failing to beat the random-fate null (or any null) on held-out env B, seed-mean, would overturn the claim.
If the gain over the no-fate null disappears with more seeds or a longer window (the +15.0 / ~5% margin is within seed noise), the claim reduces to 'better than random only'.

If the benefit depends on the specific fixed stemness threshold (a small shift removes it, or it only holds in the narrow band between 0.015 and 0.03 o2_source), it is an artifact of the parameter choice rather than gradient-induced specialization.
A different CPM backend or 3D geometry that removes the interior O2 deficit (no hypoxia, no differentiation) would falsify generality.

findings.statement: In the oxygen arm an O2 gradient forms across the cluster and the interior differentiates: at update 40 there are 15 germ and 10 soma cells (~40% differentiated), with interior O2 ~0.57 vs rim ~0.86.
findings.inferential_scope: Single representative seed/environment readout (oxygen arm, update 40), transient quasi-static viva-cpm 2D window; the gradient and split are measured, not fit.

findings.statement: Mechanism: interior hypoxia makes the per-cell stemness ODE decay below the fixed threshold, cells switch to the low-O2-consumption soma fate, which frees O2 so that neighboring germ cells stay above the growth threshold and keep growing.
findings.inferential_scope: Mechanism is built into the model (engineered fate rule); the arms with fate off (none/clamped) lack the freed-O2 pathway and the random arm shows the placement matters. Not independently validated against data.

findings.statement: Interpretation: gradient-keyed specialization improves out-of-sample net viable growth in a moderate O2 regime, decisively over random fate and modestly (~5% on B) over no fate. The fate rule is designed (engineered); the yield benefit is emergent from the spatial O2 dynamics. It does not hold when O2 is plentiful and is unreliable when O2 is very scarce.
findings.inferential_scope: Two graded O2 regimes (A calibration, B held-out), 3 seeds, fixed a-priori threshold; off-grid regimes (0.03, 0.015) were probed informally only.

findings.statement: In a Rust CPM world with an O2 gradient, O2-keyed germ/soma differentiation beats all three nulls on the held-out environment B (o2_source 0.025): seed-mean net viable growth 285.0 (oxygen) vs 270.0 (no-fate), 270.0 (clamped-undifferentiated) and 159.7 (random-fate); out-of-sample gain +15.0. The benefit over the no-fate/clamped nulls is modest (~5%; ~20% on calibration env A: 195.7 vs 163.3); over random fate it is decisive (random soma wastes growth).
findings.inferential_scope: Transient ~40-update quasi-static readout of one CPM backend (viva-cpm), 2D, 3 seeds per arm. The stemness threshold is fixed a priori (not tuned to data), so this tests generalization across two O2 regimes, not a data-fit cross-validation. The benefit vanishes when O2 is plentiful (o2_source 0.03, no hypoxia, oxygen == none) and degrades/noisy when O2 is very scarce (0.015, over-differentiation, ~20/25 soma); those regimes were probed informally, not in the graded runs. Metric choice (net viable growth) is owner-sanctioned ruling S05-B.
